title: Detector Finding
description: A single candidate contradiction returned by a detector. The provenance field defaults to 'undetermined' and must be set by hand: no detector may attribute a defect to a source rather than to the analyst's translation of it (paper §12).

status.description: candidate: returned by a detector, not adjudicated. confirmed: adjudicated against source text or verified by a reasoner. withdrawn: retracted with reason. external: the relevant structure lies in an instrument outside the corpus and cannot be scored as a source-level failure.

provenance.description: Whether the defect belongs to the source or to the extraction. Defaults to undetermined; a detector must never emit 'source'.

pathway_matches.description: Provisions accepted as invocation pathways. The fan-out of this list is reported in aggregate: a rate produced by a matcher whose fan-out is unreported cannot be interpreted (paper §10.4).

external_reference.description: The outside instrument on which the pathway depends, where status is 'external'.
